lines.en: scene happydays2
I find Maya sitting in her usual spot, on the ledge of the[school] building, looking up at the sky without any regard for her safety.
lines.zh: 我发现 Maya 坐在她平日常坐的地方——[school] 楼的窗台上，仰头望着天空，全然不顾自己的安危。

lines.en: : I thought I’d find you here.
lines.zh: : 我就知道能在这儿找到你。

lines.en: : Saying it like that makes it sound like I was trying to hide from you.
lines.zh: : 这么说，听着倒像是我存心躲你似的。

lines.en: : Well, you were. Weren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你本来就是在躲我，不是吗？

lines.en: scene happydays3
: Hahah! Yeah...I guess so...
lines.zh: : 哈哈！是啊……大概是吧……

lines.en: scene happydays4
: Whose fault is that, though, Mr. “We need to have an important talk today?”
lines.zh: : 可这怪谁呢，“今天我们必须好好谈一谈”先生？

lines.en: : That’s an incredibly long last name. Please just call me what you always call me.
lines.zh: : 这个姓也太长了。请还是用你平时对我的称呼叫我吧。

lines.en: : Darling? My love? Babe? Which one do you want? I call you lots of stuff.
lines.zh: : 亲爱的？我的爱人？宝贝？你想要哪个？我对你的叫法可多了。

lines.en: : On second thought, call me whatever you want. We need to get serious for a second.
lines.zh: : 算了，你想叫我什么都行。我们得认真谈一会儿。

lines.en: : I don’t have time to joke about all of your weird pet names for me.
lines.zh: : 我没空拿你那些奇怪的爱称开玩笑。

lines.en: scene happydays5
: Okay, okay. But this is exactly why I was hiding up here.
lines.zh: : 好好好。可这正是我躲到上面来的原因啊。

lines.en: : I’m not great with all of that serious stuff.
lines.zh: : 我不太擅长应付“认真”这种东西。

lines.en: : I get really worried and it makes my chest hurt and my palms get all sweaty and it’s a million-percent no bueno.
lines.zh: : 我会特别紧张，紧张到胸口发疼、手心全是汗，绝对是百分之一百万的不妙。

lines.en: : So if it’s something we could just bang out before lunch time, that would be awesome.
lines.zh: : 所以如果能赶在午饭前速战速决，那就太好了。

lines.en: : Unless you’re going to tell me that someone died or something. Then we can take a little longer.
lines.zh: : 除非你要告诉我谁死了之类的。那我们可以多花点时间。

lines.en: : Still, though. Lunch is kind of the main goal here.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，午饭才是这里的主要目标。

lines.en: : I promise it won’t take long.
lines.zh: : 我保证不会太久。

lines.en: : I just wanted to let you know that I think I might be [[redacted] right now.
lines.zh: : 我只是想告诉你，我觉得自己现在可能 [[redacted] 了。

lines.en: : [[redacted]? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : [[redacted]？你在说什么？

lines.en: : If this is some sort of pickup line, they’re not really of any use anymore now that we’re...you know.
lines.zh: : 如果这是什么搭讪台词，那现在也没什么用了，毕竟我们都已经……你知道的。

lines.en: : Sorry. Let me clarify.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我说清楚点。

lines.en: : I was just wandering through the [[redacted] when I saw [[redacted] and thought ssssssssssssssssssssssssssss.
lines.zh: : 我刚才在 [[redacted] 里闲逛，看见了 [[redacted]，然后就想 ssssssssssssssssssssssssssss。

lines.en: : That does actually sound really serious. The last time that happened, we [[redacted].
lines.zh: : 这听起来确实很严重。上次发生这种事的时候，我们 [[redacted]。

lines.en: : Exactly. Which is why I wanted to come find you before it becomes more of an issue.
lines.zh: : 正是。所以我才想在它变成更大的麻烦之前来找你。

lines.en: : Is that really it? You could have just texted me that.
lines.zh: : 就这事儿？你发条短信告诉我就行了啊。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. But...
lines.zh: : 嗯，是。不过……

lines.en: : But what?
lines.zh: : 不过什么？

lines.en: : {size=-15}I kind of wanted to see you...or something.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}我有点想见你……之类的。{/size}

lines.en: scene happydays6
: Ah- What the hell?!
lines.zh: : 啊——你搞什么鬼？！

lines.en: : You know I don’t like corny lines like that!
lines.zh: : 你知道我不喜欢那种肉麻台词！

lines.en: : And I don’t like saying them.
lines.zh: : 我也不喜欢说。

lines.en: : But...here we are.
lines.zh: : 不过……我们就是说到这儿了。

lines.en: scene happydays7
: Yup...here we are...
lines.zh: : 是啊……就是说到这儿了……

lines.en: : And umm...thanks...
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……谢谢……

lines.en: : I guess...
lines.zh: : 大概吧……

lines.en: : Even if I don’t like corny lines, it still makes me happy hearing them from you.
lines.zh: : 就算我不喜欢肉麻台词，从你嘴里听到，我还是会开心。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad...
lines.zh: : 嗯，那就好……

lines.en: An awkward silence blows in along with the breeze and dances around the two of us.
lines.zh: 一阵尴尬的沉默随微风吹来，绕着我们俩打转。

lines.en: Maya’s hair gets pushed into her eyes and she opens her mouth, blowing upward to push it back away.
lines.zh: Maya 的头发被风吹进了眼睛，她张开嘴向上吹气，想把头发吹开。

lines.en: I'm not sure why, though.
lines.zh: 不过我不太明白为什么。

lines.en: I mean, she’s not looking at anything important. She’s just staring over the ledge the same way she always does when the two of us come up here.
lines.zh: 我是说，她又没在看什么要紧的东西。她只是越过窗台边往下望，跟我们俩每次上来时一模一样。

lines.en: But hey, I guess maybe she just wanted to get a better view of the ground or something.
lines.zh: 不过嘿，大概她只是想把地面看得更清楚一点之类的。

lines.en: Okay, looks like I’m going to have to be the one to break the silence as she’s still dwelling on her embarrassment from a few moments ago.
lines.zh: 好吧，看来得由我来打破沉默了——她还陷在刚才那阵害臊里出不来。

lines.en: : Well, now that that’s out of the way, we can talk about anything you’d like.
lines.zh: : 好了，既然那件事说开了，你想聊什么都可以。

lines.en: scene happydays8
: Oh? Anything, you say?
lines.zh: : 哦？你说什么都可以？

lines.en: : So if I asked you where you re-hid all of those magazines I found under your bed, you’d tell me?
lines.zh: : 那要是我问你，我在你床底下翻出来的那些杂志被你重新藏到哪儿了，你也会告诉我？

lines.en: : Okay, almost anything. There are some secrets a man must never reveal.
lines.zh: : 好吧，几乎什么都可以。有些秘密，男人是永远不会说的。

lines.en: : Pervert. Lecher. Debauchee.
lines.zh: : 变态。色鬼。淫棍。

lines.en: : I hope you know that God watches you while you jerk off.
lines.zh: : 你最好知道，你打飞机的时候上帝在看着你。

lines.en: : Does that mean he also watches us when we have sex?
lines.zh: : 那他是不是也看着我们做爱？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t blame him if he did. I’m kind of adorable.
lines.zh: : 他要是真看，我也不能怪他。我可是挺可爱的。

lines.en: scene happydays9
: But I guess we should stop talking about stuff like that before anyone hears us.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，在被人听见之前，我们还是别聊这些了。

lines.en: : There is something I’ve been wanting to ask you, and I guess now is as good a time as any to do it.
lines.zh: : 有件事我一直想问你，我想现在就是个合适的时机。

lines.en: : Oh? What is it?
lines.zh: : 哦？是什么？

lines.en: : Come a little closer. You’re standing annoyingly far away and I don’t want to keep shouting.
lines.zh: : 再靠近点。你站得远得烦人，我可不想一直喊。

lines.en: : People are starting to walk by underneath me and might think I’m talking to myself or going insane or something like that.
lines.zh: : 下面开始有人走过去了，他们会以为我在自言自语，或者发疯了之类的。

lines.en: scene happydays10
I take a few steps closer to Maya and stare into her [[closed] eyes as she searches through her mind to find whatever topic it is she’s curious about today.
lines.zh: 我朝 Maya 走近几步，凝视着她那双 [[closed] 的眼睛，而她在脑子里翻找着今天到底好奇哪个话题。

lines.en: I swear, I can never even fathom what things she’s going to bring up.
lines.zh: 我发誓，我永远猜不到她接下来要提什么。

lines.en: Just the other day, she was educating me on some weird religious theory she heard about a...computer, I think?
lines.zh: 就在前几天，她还在给我科普一个她听来的奇怪宗教理论，好像是关于一台……电脑？

lines.en: I can’t remember.
lines.zh: 我记不清了。

lines.en: All I know is that it was really strange and just completely went over my head.
lines.zh: 我只知道那玩意儿特别奇怪，完全超出了我的理解范围。

lines.en: scene happydays11
: Okay, so this might sound kind of serious.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这个听起来可能有点严肃。

lines.en: : But that’s only because...well, it {i}is{/i} kind of serious.
lines.zh: : 不过那只是因为……嗯，它{i}确实{/i}有点严肃。

lines.en: : Oh?
: It’s about how baby finches are sometimes eaten by their parents before they ever leave the nest.
lines.zh: : 是关于雀宝宝有时候会在离巢之前，被自己的父母吃掉的事。

lines.en: : This again?
lines.zh: : 又来？

lines.en: : No, no, no. Hear me out.
lines.zh: : 不不不。听我说完。

lines.en: : Sometimes, if the baby finch isn't learning to fly quickly enough or if it just looks weak or something like that, the papa or mama bird literally peck at its head until it dies.
lines.zh: : 有时候，如果雀宝宝学飞学得不够快，或者看起来很虚弱什么的，鸟爸爸或鸟妈妈就会真的去啄它的头，直到把它啄死。

lines.en: : Its brains get turned to mush and, before you know it, it’s just dead right there in the nest.
lines.zh: : 它的脑子被啄成糊状，不知不觉间，就这么死在巢里了。

lines.en: : It’s actually an extremely common problem for people who raise or breed finches.
lines.zh: : 事实上，这对养雀或繁殖雀的人来说，是个极其常见的问题。

lines.en: : And so, when I was thinking about this the other day, I realized that you and I would be kind of like finch-parents if we ever had a kid.
lines.zh: : 所以前几天我琢磨这件事的时候意识到，如果我和你有了孩子，我们大概就会像那种雀父母。

lines.en: : Are you implying I’d kill my child for being weak?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示我会因为孩子软弱就杀了他？

lines.en: : Are you implying you wouldn’t?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示你不会吗？

lines.en: : {i}Yes{/i}.
: But you hate babies. We both do.
lines.zh: : 可你讨厌婴儿。我们都讨厌。

lines.en: : So if there was a chance to kinda just poke at its little head until it was no more, I’d probably take it.
lines.zh: : 所以如果有机会就这么戳它的小脑袋，直到它不复存在，我大概会照做。

lines.en: I begin to wonder how soft a child’s head would be in my bare hands and how easy (Or difficult) it would be for me to apply enough pressure to cause it to cave in.
lines.zh: 我开始好奇，一个孩子的头在我的赤手中有多软，我要用多大力气（或者说难不难）才能把它按得凹陷下去。

lines.en: My mind races back to my years of childhood- and I’ve got to say, I’m pretty thankful no one ever did that to me or Maya.
lines.zh: 我的思绪飞回了自己的童年——不得不说，我很庆幸从来没人对我也好、对 Maya 也好，做过这种事。

lines.en: I don’t even know what I’d do if my head was squished when I was a baby.
lines.zh: 我都不知道，要是我还是婴儿的时候脑袋被压扁了，我会怎么样。

lines.en: Probably not be here, though. Lol!
lines.zh: 大概就不会在这儿了吧。哈哈！

lines.en: scene happydays12
: Did you know that three days after death, the enzymes in your digestive system start digesting your body?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，人死后三天，消化系统里的酶就会开始消化你自己的身体？

lines.en: : Imagine what it’s like just living inside of something that dies. You probably wouldn’t even realize at first.
lines.zh: : 想象一下，住在一个正在死去的东西里面是什么感觉。一开始你大概根本不会察觉。

lines.en: : You’d just be sitting there thinking to yourself, “Huh. It’s getting awfully dark lately.”
lines.zh: : 你就那么坐着，心里想着：“咦。最近怎么黑得这么厉害。”

lines.en: : Then, without really thinking much of it, you’d just start eating your house because you run out of other stuff to do.
lines.zh: : 然后，也没多想，你就会开始啃自己的房子，因为实在没别的事可做了。

lines.en: : But, in a roundabout way, I guess that means baby finches might be able to get revenge on their parents in some timelines.
lines.zh: : 不过绕了一圈，我想这意味着在某些时间线里，雀宝宝是能向父母复仇的。

lines.en: : Like if the parent dies before the baby dies, they can just start feeding away on the parent’s body even more than they do by default of just...being babies.
lines.zh: : 比如如果父母先死、宝宝还没死，它们就可以在父母身上大快朵颐，比它们作为……小宝宝本来就会做的还要过分。

lines.en: : Wait, never mind. That wouldn't work because birds lay eggs instead of giving live-birth.
lines.zh: : 等等，当我没说。这行不通，因为鸟是下蛋的，不是胎生。

lines.en: : Sorry. I’m really fucking high right now and killed a kitten on the way to[school].
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我现在嗨得不行，而且在来 [school] 的路上弄死了一只小猫。

lines.en: : Another one? That’s the third one this week!
lines.zh: : 又一只？这周都第三只了！

lines.en: : Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene happydays13
: Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Hahahahahahahahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: We laugh and then touch hands.
lines.zh: 我们笑完，然后手碰到了一起。

lines.en: Maya’s hands are much smaller than mine.
lines.zh: Maya 的手比我的小得多。

lines.en: They make my penis look bigger than it actually is, though, so that’s a cool plus-side to them.
lines.zh: 不过这样反而显得我的阴茎比实际更大，算是个不错的加分项。

lines.en: Not like there are any downsides to small hands other than just, the amount of stuff you can hold with them.
lines.zh: 小手也没什么别的缺点，无非就是能拿的东西少一点。

lines.en: I don’t think Maya would be able to palm a basketball, either. But I can, so I’m clearly a more advanced human being than she is.
lines.zh: 我想 Maya 也没法单手抓起一颗篮球。可我能，所以显然我是比她更高级的人类。

lines.en: scene happydays12
: Oh, did you want to stop by anywhere after[school] today?
lines.zh: : 哦，今天 [school] 放学后你想顺路去哪儿吗？

lines.en: : I think the others wanted to go to karaoke and were going to ask you about it, so I might as well ask you before they have the chance to.
lines.zh: : 其他人好像想去唱卡拉 OK，还打算问你，那我不如抢在他们之前先问。

lines.en: : Mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm I don’t know. I’ve got some stuff to do today.
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯……我不知道。我今天还有事要做。

lines.en: : What kind of stuff? Tell me.
lines.zh: : 什么事？告诉我。

lines.en: : I was thinking of memorizing Beethoven’s-
lines.zh: : 我在想背一下贝多芬的——

lines.en: : I just remembered another thing about baby finches. Want to hear?
lines.zh: : 我又想起一件关于雀宝宝的事。想听吗？

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Another reason for the murder of children that the finch-community (Yes, it’s a thing) has gotten behind is that the male parent might murder children just so it can get them out of the nest.
lines.zh: : 雀类圈（对，真有这么个圈子）认同的另一种“杀婴”理由是：鸟爸爸可能会杀掉幼鸟，好把它们赶出巢去。

lines.en: : It’s not a territorial issue or anything like that, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这跟领地意识什么的没关系。

lines.en: scene happydays13
: Most people seem to believe that it’s just because the male is so excited to mate again that it destroys its offspring in order to get some of that sweet bird pussy a little bit sooner.
lines.zh: : 大多数人似乎认为，只是因为雄鸟急着再交配，才毁掉自己的后代，好早点尝到那甜美的鸟批。

lines.en: : Crazy!
lines.zh: : 疯了！

lines.en: : I know, right?! The things animals are willing to do just to get laid are crazy.
lines.zh: : 就是说啊！动物为了能上床什么都干得出来，太疯狂了。

lines.en: scene happydays1
: They kind of remind me of you!
lines.zh: : 它们让我想起你！

lines.en: : Again, I’m not the type of person who would kill a child.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我不是那种会杀小孩的人。

lines.en: : Maybe not. But you {i}are{/i} the type of person who likes sex so much that you get addicted.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。可你{i}确实{/i}属于那种太喜欢做爱、以至于会上瘾的人。

lines.en: : I swear, it’s like there’s not even an escape with you sometimes!
lines.zh: : 我发誓，有时候跟你在一起根本无处可逃！

lines.en: : Like, I’ll be out buying groceries to bring back to my apartment and you’ll just text me saying “Let’s fuuuuuuuuck” and I’ve gotta be like “UGH fine.”
lines.zh: : 比如我出门买菜准备回公寓，你就发短信说“我们来做…………爱吧”，我就只能“呃……行吧”。

lines.en: scene happydays14
: Fragments of memories stitched together haphazardly until they resemble something close to a desire.
lines.zh: : 记忆的碎片被胡乱缝合在一起，直到它们拼凑出某种近似欲望的东西。

lines.en: : Hm? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你在说什么？

lines.en: scene happydays15
: You aren’t allowed to slip into hexadecimal while I’m talking to you.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说话的时候，不许你突然切换成十六进制。

lines.en: : It’s very distracting.
lines.zh: : 那很让人分心。

lines.en: : I don’t speak “numbers.”
lines.zh: : 我不会说“数字”。

lines.en: I give up on everything and go back to normal.
lines.zh: 我放弃一切挣扎，恢复正常。

lines.en: Maya and I spend the next three hours on top of the roof talking about the habits of birds and the places we plan to have sex before we die.
lines.zh: 接下来的三个小时，我和 Maya 在楼顶聊着鸟类的习性，以及我们死之前打算在哪些地方做爱。

lines.en: Some of the places on that list are:
lines.zh: 那份清单上的一些地方是：

lines.en: A swimming pool.
lines.zh: 一个游泳池。

lines.en: The produce section of the supermarket.
lines.zh: 超市的蔬果区。

lines.en: The moon (Improbable).
lines.zh: 月球（不太可能）。

lines.en: And her parents’ house.
lines.zh: 还有她父母家。

lines.en: That’s the one I’m most excited for.
lines.zh: 那是我最期待的一个。

lines.en: Not because I dislike her parents or anything. In fact, I’ve never even really heard her talk about them.
lines.zh: 不是因为我讨厌她父母什么的。事实上，我从来没怎么听她提起过他们。

lines.en: But the idea of sex in a sex place sounds sexy.
lines.zh: 可在“做爱的地方”做爱这个点子，听起来就很性感。

lines.en: I can’t wait to do sex to her there.
lines.zh: 我迫不及待想在那儿跟她做爱。

lines.en: scene happydays13
: Hey, Maya.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Maya。

lines.en: : Yes, my love?
lines.zh: : 在呢，我的爱人？

lines.en: : Do you ever feel like someone is watching you?
lines.zh: : 你有没有觉得有人在看着你？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然有。

lines.en: : All the time.
lines.zh: : 一直都有。

lines.en: : We were just talking about it before, weren’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们刚才不就在聊这个吗？

lines.en: : God is always watching. That’s pretty much all he does.
lines.zh: : 上帝一直在看着。他基本上就干这一件事。

lines.en: : He just sits there with his roots planted in the ground and waits for flakes of our skin to fall so he can absorb them and learn things about us.
lines.zh: : 他只是把根扎在地里坐在那儿，等着我们身上的皮屑掉下来，好吸收掉，借此了解我们。

lines.en: : For example, God probably knows what color underwear I’m wearing and-
lines.zh: : 比如说，上帝大概知道我穿的是什么颜色的内裤，而且——

lines.en: : Green.
lines.zh: : 绿色。

lines.en: : Hey! No fair! You peeked!
lines.zh: : 嘿！不公平！你偷看了！

lines.en: : I didn’t. You just exclusively wear green underwear.
lines.zh: : 我没有。你只是只穿绿色内裤而已。

lines.en: scene happydays6
: Ugh...you’re the worst sometimes. You know that?
lines.zh: : 呃……你有时候真是最差劲的。你知道吗？

lines.en: : sssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssss
lines.zh: : ssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssss

lines.en: scene happydays2
: So anyway, what is it you wanted to talk about?
lines.zh: : 那么话说回来，你到底想聊什么？

lines.en: : If it’s something we could just bang out before lunch time, that would be awesome.
lines.zh: : 所以如果能赶在午饭前速战速决，那就太好了。

lines.en: : Unless you’re going to tell me that someone died or something. Then we can take a little longer.
lines.zh: : 除非你要告诉我谁死了之类的。那我们可以多花点时间。

lines.en: : Still, though. Lunch is kind of the main goal here.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，午饭才是这里的主要目标。

lines.en: : I promise it won’t take long.
lines.zh: : 我保证不会太久。

lines.en: : I just wanted to let you know that I think I might be [[redacted] right now.
lines.zh: : 我只是想告诉你，我觉得自己现在可能 [[redacted] 了。

lines.en: scene happydays5
: [[redacted]? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : [[redacted]？你在说什么？

lines.en: : If this is some sort of pickup line, they’re not really of any use anymore now that we’re...you know.
lines.zh: : 如果这是什么搭讪台词，那现在也没什么用了，毕竟我们都已经……你知道的。

lines.en: : Sorry. Let me clarify.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我说清楚点。

lines.en: : I was just wandering through the [[redacted] when I saw [[redacted] and thought ssssssssssssssssssssssssssss.
lines.zh: : 我刚才在 [[redacted] 里闲逛，看见了 [[redacted]，然后就想 ssssssssssssssssssssssssssss。

lines.en: : That does actually sound really serious. The last time that happened, we [[redacted].
lines.zh: : 这听起来确实很严重。上次发生这种事的时候，我们 [[redacted]。

lines.en: : Exactly. Which is why I wanted to come find you before it becomes more of an issue.
lines.zh: : 正是。所以我才想在它变成更大的麻烦之前来找你。

lines.en: : Is that really it? You could have just texted me that.
lines.zh: : 就这事儿？你发条短信告诉我就行了啊。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. But...
lines.zh: : 嗯，是。不过……

lines.en: : But what?
lines.zh: : 不过什么？

lines.en: : {size=-15}I kind of wanted to see you...or something.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}我有点想见你……之类的。{/size}

lines.en: scene happydays6
: Ah! Watch what you’re saying!
lines.zh: : 啊！你说话注意点！

lines.en: : Pervert! Lecher! Debauchee!
lines.zh: : 变态！色鬼！淫棍！

lines.en: : Hey, didn’t we just talk about this?
lines.zh: : 嘿，我们不是刚聊过这个吗？

lines.en: scene happydays16
: Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : We’ve run out of other things to talk about.
lines.zh: : 我们已经没别的可聊了。

lines.en: : This is the part where we cycle back around and repeat ourselves.
lines.zh: : 到了这里，我们就又开始循环、重复自己。

lines.en: : We’ve been doing this for how long now? Have you really forgotten?
lines.zh: : 我们这样重复多久了？你真的忘了？

lines.en: : What’s going on with you? You’ve been acting weird all morning.
lines.zh: : 你怎么了？你一早上都怪怪的。

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : I just feel like I was in the middle of something.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得自己正做到一半什么事。

lines.en: : The middle of what?
lines.zh: : 一半的什么？

lines.en: : What could possibly be more important than spending quality time with your girlfriend on top of the[school] building?
lines.zh: : 有什么能比在 [school] 楼顶陪女朋友共度美好时光更重要？

lines.en: : You’re not my girlfriend, though.
lines.zh: : 可你不是我女朋友啊。

lines.en: : I’m not?
lines.zh: : 我不是？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: scene happydays17
: You’re breaking up with me?...
lines.zh: : 你要跟我分手？……

lines.en: : I’m not breaking up with anyone. We were never together.
lines.zh: : 我没有跟谁分手。我们从来就没在一起过。

lines.en: scene happydays18
: Stop saying that!
lines.zh: : 别再说了！

lines.en: : I have to go now.
lines.zh: : 我现在得走了。

lines.en: : Go where?!
lines.zh: : 去哪儿？！

lines.en: : What are you doing?!
lines.zh: : 你在做什么？！

lines.en: scene happydays19
: Wha-
: STOP!
lines.zh: : 住手！

lines.en: : SENSEI!
lines.zh: : SENSEI！

lines.en: : PLEASE!
lines.zh: : 求你了！

lines.en: Hope is the thing with a beautiful sick rose that you can find beauty in the strange proportions and life is yes.
lines.zh: 希望是一朵带着美丽病态的玫瑰，你能在那怪异的比例中找到美，而生命是肯定的。

lines.en: Hooray!
lines.zh: 万岁！

lines.en: Time to celebrate!
lines.zh: 该庆祝了！
